regions.merged_text: "Reason, as the mistress of the little kingdom within each one of us, should call the will to frequent account, and the other faculties of the soul & senses of the body - as the stuart & other ser- vants are called, that the master may know how his business stands, i.e. his profits & losses - & to see that each one of his house hold receives enough and nothing superfluous or extravagant. S. Chrysostum

regions.merged_text: 8/31/1900 Indignant remark & consolation when on Sunday after, I acknowledged my fault. Consider the contrast between the biogra- phies of the two saintly friends Athanatius & Basilius (who never saw each other on Earth) the former the champion of the Second Person of the Bl. Trinity; the lat- ter that of the Holy Ghost. -- Fortitude in different colors, etc.
